## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete failure or need and the behavior this change provides.

## Verification

Record the relevant checks and their results, the reviewed revision, and any
remaining limitations. Resolve every actionable finding with evidence. Never
paste conversations, private runtime state, credentials or sensitive outputs.

## Risk

State Quick / Standard / Deep, affected boundaries and the independent review
coverage. An agent report does not replace a human approval required by the
repository or hosting service.

## Recovery

State how to disable or revert this change, which data or consumers are affected,
and how to verify recovery. Revert only with the owner's authorization.
